asks: Is somebody coming, or is it just you?
description: A table stands here, laid for one, every object on it in the only place it could be, and the chair pulled out at exactly the angle somebody leaves a chair.
emotes: The glass on {it} rings once and stops.
The chair at {it} moves out another inch, hospitably.
looks: The fold in the cloth has been like that since before the table.
The salt is the whole of the argument, settled.
You move something a centimetre and put it back, ashamed.
name: a small table, laid for one
says: Sit. It has been ready a long time.
